[h2]Hello Hunters! [/h2][h3]We hope you’ve been enjoying your Day Out in Yomi—we know we have. Huge thanks to everyone who's taken time out of their summer to help take down that fearsome Oni. Don't get too excited though... we're just tuning things up a bit.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Animation Bug when rolling after firing – Only in multiplayer, of course. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Issue Preventing Tablet Use on Quads – You can now multitask like a real hunter. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed walking with emotes still playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed getting stuck after shooting or reloading with emotes playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse cursor not auto focusing the game after map loading[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial outro cinematic not capturing mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed slime droppings doing repeated damage and quickly killing the player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an Issue Causing Goob to Steal the Quads in the FOB[/p][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: Devlog 1.0 [June 2024]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png[/img]

[h3]Welcome to our seventh devlog!  It's been quite awhile since the last one. 

Let's take a look at what's coming soon for update [b]1.0[/b]![/h3]

[h3]That's right.

This next update A Day Out is leaving [b]Early Access[/b]. Exciting right?[/h3]

[h3]And don't fret, there's still more content and bug fixes post-release![/h3]

[previewyoutube=wUYFQxkNQ9c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]If you're interested in playtesting all these new features, the 1.0 Beta build is available on the Beta branch of the game. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/y2hE6CUxKt]Discord[/url] for more information.[/h3]


[u][h1]Recent Progress[/h1][/u]
[h2]Money System[/h2]
Money has been added to the game and is earned by completing cases, bounties and finding it in the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/110386b5cbfa5402a3e2ae84e4df58667f7b0863.png[/img]
[i]The tablet has been updated.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/97c7fc3d9bddcd8cae3fa79d830f114d134ceca7.png[/img]
[i]The FOB PC has also been updated.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7a8c028eb4905f3437b1fbe3dff3e07fcb0a22de.png[/img]
[i]Collectible cash has been added.[/i]

[h2]Bounties[/h2]
Bounty contracts have been added to the FOB PC and can be taken on to earn money between cases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/5b9bec1f7eb58df900fe1da147908c0183c76372.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/25ff31572bbcae5edce9ace86121ebe2aef1e1b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/291602f5a11cf4bfc1d54f443d57a1f1306fd4da.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7f2ac0d904448918d915c61f7672fec90321ef7e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3020f97eed689843ea8817d0aac2813c4c58eb20.jpg[/img]
[i]Bounties can be found in the bounties folder on the FOB PC. 
They show up randomly and can be replayed as many times as you want.[/i]


[h3]You're probably wondering what all this new money is good for.[/h3]


(It's this)
[h2]Loadout Whiteboard[/h2]
A new whiteboard has been added to The FOB. You can use it to organize your loadout for cases and bounties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/331b2b684addf72036c132a8423790018e770fa5.png[/img]
[i]The whiteboard lists all your chosen items and remaining money.
Only the host can choose the loadout.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/9a63d4d23671ac01b20637bc09d70a0b3b30716d.jpg[/img]
[i]Your loadout can be found inside the tan military crates at the start of the case.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/8158cb995b0e2c073a4a02a95fee85f857e3a9da.png[/img]
[i]At the end of a case or bounty, all players will be rewarded and the host will have their loadout refunded.
However if you lose or abort, your loadout costs won't be covered.[/i]

[h2]Gadgets[/h2]
[i]Gadgets are a new class of item that can be used to hunt, lure and kill monsters.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e0d90b3acc173850939eb0ea247822444cb98bdf.jpg[/img]
[i]Ground Sensors are used to detect sources of movement and display them on the map.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/005083c49faea7415d709a9730731cf6721959c1.jpg[/img]
[i]The map screen will show the location of detected movement.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e9ec967f8b3e59e9163b4aebae4d02ab4a5fbfb0.jpg[/img]
[i]Traps can now be baited and will lure monsters to them.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/ca8cfb9f2e4bcedf0cd8652a388540649504d9ae.jpg[/img]
[i]A mine and many new grenades have been added. Frag, Flame, Stun and Molotov.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/951e97f395cfd50ebe2b44b6a001a4c43e4474b8.jpg[/img]
[i]The Minigun is an automatic turret that engages any non-human life it detects.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/463cf58c4afc6c16c756077c078d310132d0ddc6.jpg[/img]
[i]The Tactical Decoy is a state-of-the-art top secret device for luring any and all monsters.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/b573634161fc1fda0d4e2af90dfc3d5a5f805cfb.jpg[/img]
[i]Night Vision is good for hunting in dark forests or pitch black interiors.[/i]

[h2]Furniture Customization[/h2]
[i]You can now customize different areas of the FOB in different themes.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/a5cbe5099ff6c9c9fbbd0852c2a2d5d0e0b5cec2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/408761d39221a969edb4a91dbddea0f053b25d59.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3be919e509b8b19a99804b8e9fb56a8472f0cf4d.jpg[/img]
[i]These are only a handful of the available options. More areas can also be customized.[/i]

[h2]Body Camera[/h2]
[i]A new Body Camera has been added that enables a more immersive experience. 
It also includes a useful zoom feature when aiming while not holding a weapon.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/aff1d8547a616db6f38845c77fc62c01b4fca397.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 [December 2021]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png[/img]

Welcome to our third devlog.  Check it out! And thanks for reading!

[u][h1]Recent Progress[/h1][/u]

[h2]Virtual Cursor[/h2]
We created a Virtual Cursor that can be used to interact with screens in the world space. The Virtual Cursor can be controlled via gamepad with the left joystick. It was originally designed to be used for interacting with the new tablet, but later we'll expand on it and add more interactable screens like computers, televisions and touchscreens.

[h2]Interactable Tablet[/h2]
The new Interactable Tablet will be the main interface used during every case in the game. It contains several 'apps' that enable access to different features. The tablet itself is in the world space, but always accessible on the player character.
[i](Similar to a certain wrist bound computer from a game with vaults)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6cd8e927e0e74f120cefe3055d03c334260f9db9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/68fde3c248a199ce3cf615ee4d0426618d5db379.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Map: Interactable map with waypoints and landmarks
[*] Inventory: The player's inventory
[*] Objectives: The case objectives
[*] Devices: An interface used to remote control various items (camera, drone, etc.)
[*] Recordings: An interface to playback audio logs found in the world
[/list]

[h2]Player Inventory:[/h2]
The Player Inventory can be accessed via the Interactable Tablet. Use it to select your weapons and preview any item in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3a5f745a546453c001e380667dfd1e7efca1cd99.png[/img]

Additionally, the inventory also shows the stats for a weapon upon hovering over it.

The Inventory has a feature for 'favoriting' your weapons and assigning them to a specific shortcut slot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7727c2afc1ee4d946b2591643a7b4cb9df6dceac.png[/img]
[i](The circle icons are placeholders. Icons unique to each item will be added later)[/i]

[h2]New Snow Effect[/h2]
We thought our old snow looked a little too dull, so we made it more interesting and dynamic. Snow will now deform when a player or monster walks over it, leaving a visible trail behind.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e6b972038c04cd2c73c63738db879def8161ba3a.png[/img]

Welcome to the first devlog. We'll be showing off the current state of the game and revealing our future plans so you have a reason to get excited. So take a close look! 👀

[u][h1]Current Progress[/h1][/u]
[i]Alright, let's see what we've got done already.[/i]

[h2]New Maps:[/h2]
The maps in A Day Out are where you'll run into supernatural creatures, depending on the case you choose. Each map varies in size from small islands to large forests or deserts. The larger maps often have hidden or secluded locations to discover such as caves, cabins, bunkers, houses, factories and warehouses. [i]Filled with loot of course.[/i]

[h2]Inspection System:[/h2]
The inspection system allows players to interect with objects and read some info about it. You can also rotate and zoom the item in 3D to get a better look. This system will be useful for learning about items players should be aware of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3d3ea3bd5163c5278722d69774fd0d9404b9975c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3567dd2aea86d25304806623bb0eccf35aa50f55.png[/img]
Notes are a special item that display the text written on them.

[h2]Visual Case Scripting System:[/h2]
Our custom made "Visual Case Scripting System" will enable designers to rapidly develop linear event driven cases for the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/cbe74014037ad2ac06cc9b720c91c788ffe8fca8.png[/img]
[i](It makes creating cases really easy so we can spend more time on designing the case as well as possible)[/i]

[h2]Game HUD:[/h2]
Although the HUD is still under development, it's still functional in it's current state. The HUD currently has a compass for navigating, weapon status, stamina and health bars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/60ecfb704a82f49f5203ba392c0e865d79bab6d8.png[/img]

[u][h1]Future Plans[/h1][/u]
[i]The good stuff. Let's get into it.[/i]

Disclaimer:
[i]The order of the features listed is not necessarily the order these features will be completed.[/i]
[i]Some features may not be ready for the Early Access release.[/i]
[i](In other words, no promises)[/i]
